name: Finalize Operation (Atomic)
query:
SELECT c.operation_id, c.operation_status, c.mutation_status, c.response_json
FROM public.flow_up_complete_operation(
  $1::uuid,
  NULLIF(NULLIF($2::text, '__NULL__'), ''),
  NULLIF(NULLIF($3::text, '__NULL__'), ''),
  NULLIF(NULLIF($4::text, '__NULL__'), ''),
  NULLIF(convert_from(decode(NULLIF($5::text, '__NULL__'), 'base64'), 'UTF8'), '')::jsonb,
  NULLIF(NULLIF($6::text, '__NULL__'), ''),
  NULLIF(convert_from(decode(NULLIF($7::text, '__NULL__'), 'base64'), 'UTF8'), '')::jsonb
) c
LIMIT 1;
queryReplacement: ={{ [$("Prepare Operation Finalize Input").item.json.finalize_clinic_id || "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", $("Prepare Operation Finalize Input").item.json.finalize_operation_id || "__NULL__", $("Prepare Operation Finalize Input").item.json.finalize_status || "INCONCLUSIVE", $("Prepare Operation Finalize Input").item.json.finalize_mutation_status || "UNKNOWN", $("Prepare Operation Finalize Input").item.json.finalize_response_b64 || "__NULL__", $("Prepare Operation Finalize Input").item.json.finalize_child_execution_id || "__NULL__", $("Prepare Operation Finalize Input").item.json.finalize_last_error_b64 || "__NULL__" ] }}
notes: P1.6: record terminal or inconclusive mutation outcome atomically.
